import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long K;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] elements;
        int rows;
        int cols;

        public Matrix() {
            this.rows = 0;
            this.cols = 0;
            this.elements = new long[0][0];
        }

        public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            this.rows = rows;
            this.cols = cols;
            this.elements = new long[rows][cols];
        }

        public Matrix(int n) {
            this.rows = n;
            this.cols = n;
            this.elements = new long[n][n];
        }

        public int rowCount() {
            return rows;
        }

        public int colCount() {
            return cols;
        }

        public long[] getRow(int idx) {
            return elements[idx];
        }

        public static Matrix unit(int n) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                res.elements[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        public Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < this.cols; ++j) {
                    temp.elements[i][j] = (this.elements[i][j] + other.elements[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return temp;
        }

        public Matrix subtract(Matrix other) {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < this.cols; ++j) {
                    temp.elements[i][j] = (this.elements[i][j] - other.elements[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return temp;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int r = this.rows;
            int c = other.cols;
            int m = this.cols;
            long[][] temp = new long[r][c];
            for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < c; ++j) {
                        temp[i][j] = (temp[i][j] + this.elements[i][k] * other.elements[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            Matrix result = new Matrix(r, c);
            result.elements = temp;
            return result;
        }

        public Matrix power(long exponent) {
            Matrix result = Matrix.unit(this.rows);
            Matrix base = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < this.cols; ++j) {
                    base.elements[i][j] = this.elements[i][j];
                }
            }
            while (exponent > 0) {
                if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exponent >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public void shiftRows() {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                    temp.elements[i][j] = this.elements[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                temp.elements[i][(int)K] = this.elements[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                temp.elements[(int)K][i] = this.elements[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            temp.elements[(int)K][(int)K] = this.elements[(int)K][(int)K];
            this.elements = temp.elements;
        }

        public long determinantValue() {
            Matrix copy = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < this.cols; ++j) {
                    copy.elements[i][j] = this.elements[i][j];
                }
            }
            long det = 1;
            int n = this.rows;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                int pivot = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (copy.elements[j][i] != 0) {
                        pivot = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (pivot == -1) return 0;
                if (i != pivot) {
                    det = (det * (MOD - 1)) % MOD;
                    long[] tempRow = copy.elements[i];
                    copy.elements[i] = copy.elements[pivot];
                    copy.elements[pivot] = tempRow;
                }
                det = (det * copy.elements[i][i]) % MOD;
                long inv = modInverse(copy.elements[i][i], MOD);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    copy.elements[i][j] = (copy.elements[i][j] * inv) % MOD;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                    long factor = copy.elements[j][i];
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                        copy.elements[j][k] = (copy.elements[j][k] - copy.elements[i][k] * factor) % MOD;
                        if (copy.elements[j][k] < 0) copy.elements[j][k] += MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return (det % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        private long modInverse(long a, long mod) {
            long m = mod, x = 0, y = 1;
            if (mod == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                long q = a / mod;
                long t = mod;
                mod = a % mod;
                a = t;
                t = x;
                x = y - q * x;
                y = t;
            }
            if (y < 0) y += m;
            return y;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] cache = new Matrix[70][35];

    static long powMod(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        long half = powMod(base, exp / 2);
        long result = (half * half) % MOD;
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N_val = scanner.nextLong();
        long K_val = scanner.nextLong();
        K = K_val;

        long depth = 0;
        long temp = N_val;
        while (temp >= K) {
            depth++;
            temp /= K;
        }

        cache[0][0] = Matrix.unit((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            cache[0][0].elements[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            cache[0][i] = new Matrix(cache[0][i-1].rowCount(), cache[0][i-1].colCount());
            for (int r = 0; r < cache[0][i-1].rowCount(); ++r) {
                for (int c = 0; c < cache[0][i-1].colCount(); ++c) {
                    cache[0][i].elements[r][c] = cache[0][i-1].elements[r][c];
                }
            }
            cache[0][i].shiftRows();
        }

        for (long level = 1; level <= depth; ++level) {
            cache[(int)level][0] = new Matrix(cache[(int)level-1][0].rowCount(), cache[(int)level-1][0].colCount());
            for (int r = 0; r < cache[(int)level-1][0].rowCount(); ++r) {
                for (int c = 0; c < cache[(int)level-1][0].colCount(); ++c) {
                    cache[(int)level][0].elements[r][c] = cache[(int)level-1][0].elements[r][c];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                cache[(int)level][0] = cache[(int)level-1][i].multiply(cache[(int)level][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                cache[(int)level][i] = new Matrix(cache[(int)level][i-1].rowCount(), cache[(int)level][i-1].colCount());
                for (int r = 0; r < cache[(int)level][i-1].rowCount(); ++r) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < cache[(int)level][i-1].colCount(); ++c) {
                        cache[(int)level][i].elements[r][c] = cache[(int)level][i-1].elements[r][c];
                    }
                }
                cache[(int)level][i].shiftRows();
            }
        }

        Matrix finalMatrix = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        finalMatrix.elements[(int)K][0] = 1;
        int shiftIdx = 0;

        while (depth >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
                if (powMod(K, depth) <= N_val) {
                    N_val -= powMod(K, depth);
                    finalMatrix = cache[(int)depth][shiftIdx].multiply(finalMatrix);
                    shiftIdx = (shiftIdx + 1) % (int)K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            depth--;
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            total = (total + finalMatrix.elements[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
